gbm_population_evidence.quote: Malignant Tumor; Advanced Solid Tumor; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Metastatic Cancer
Expansion cohort 1: Patients affected by GBM.

candidate_evidence.quote: First-in-human Trial of PhOx430, a First-in-class Acetylglucosaminyltransferase V Inhibitor, in Advanced Solid Tumours

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Radiologically documented progressive disease after at least one prior treatment for metastatic/advanced disease.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: DOSE ESCALATION SECONDARY OUTCOME #2 (Plasma concentration levels of PhOx430): Plasma concentration levels of PhOx430

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: to characterize the pharmacodynamics (PD) effect of PhOx430 on blood, urine and tumour samples collected before and after treatment;

role_evidence.quote: First-in-human clinical trial of the acetylglucosaminyltransferase V inhibitor PhOx430 in patients with advanced solid tumours.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral first-in-class acetylglucosaminyltransferase V (MGAT5) inhibitor

source_quote.quote: Expansion cohort 2: Patients with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), defined as estrogen receptor (ER) negative (\< 1% of nuclei reacting for ER in IHC), progesterone receptor (PgR) negative (\< 1% of nuclei reacting for PgR in IHC)

coder_notes: First-in-human basket phase 1; GBM expansion cohort 1 and 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' in conditions (historical terminology). PK is plasma only. Paired pre/post PD on tumour samples is planned (exploratory), so target_engagement_planned = yes; note tumour re-biopsy is not required for GBM patients. Unspecified 'predictive response biomarkers' exploratory objective not listed as a biomarker row. Cohorts are not separate registered arms.
